Hullo lounge team,
A visiting trainer sent an update on bedding supplies

Please keep the companion bays stocked with clean, dry bedding and check that each setup stays tidy before any animal is moved on. Our aim is to make each handoff calm and humane, so slow, clear handling matters as much as the supplies themselves. If you see a shortage, flag it early so we can replace items without delay and keep the service dependable for guests and crew.

For small dog cases, confirm that the crate fits the animal securely and that the sides meet the approved limit before loading. <<FACT F068>> Place a fresh liner inside, secure the door, and make sure the crate is steady enough for smooth transfer. For bird travel, keep the guidance handy and follow the current age rule exactly. <<FACT F077>> If a traveler asks for reassurance, answer plainly, stay kind, and point them to the standard process rather than adding extra detail.

Thank you for helping Aurelia Skyways keep the Companion Animal Travel Desk consistent and caring for every trip. Please pass along any supply concerns as soon as you notice them.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
